1.content: S denotes the starting cell; F denotes a traversable floor tile with no intrinsic reward; H denotes a hazard tile that is either impassable or yields no reward and should be avoided; G denotes the goal cell that grants a reward of 1 and ends the episode.

2.content: H denotes an impassable hazard tile; the agent cannot move onto H cells.

3.content: Agents receive a reward of 1 only when moving onto the goal tile G, which also terminates the episode; all other traversable tiles (F, S) yield zero reward.

4.content: The agent can move orthogonally (up, down, left, right) to an adjacent cell if the destination cell is within the grid bounds and is not an impassable hazard (H).

5.content: Tiles (S, F, H, G) retain their type throughout an episode; there are no state changes or dynamic elements.
